decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the battlefield while applying pressure to the opponent through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig for key cards, along with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your board, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent. With a mix of removal and threats like Murktide Regent, Orcish Bowmasters, and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, this deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game quickly.

This deck revolves around assembling a critical mass of mana acceleration and tutors to cast powerful combo spells like Tendrils of Agony and Ad Nauseam to win the game in a single turn. The focus is on generating as much mana as possible through cards like Mox Opal and Lion's Eye Diamond, while also disrupting opponents with Thoughtseize and Duress. Wishclaw Talisman and Burning Wish are used to tutor for key combo pieces, while also providing a form of card advantage. The deck aims to quickly set up a winning play while navigating around opponent's disruption.

The main concept of the deck is to use Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly ramp up mana and control the game with powerful spells like Ugin, Karn, and The One Ring. The deck aims to stall opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation while building up to powerful plays that can swing the game in its favor. With a focus on ramping up quickly and controlling the board, this deck aims to stay ahead of opponents and secure victory through overwhelming power and resource advantage.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying early pressure with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The key concept is to control the game tempo by using cards like Daze, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's plays, while deploying aggressive threats like Moonshadow, Nethergoyf, and Bilbo, Thief in the Night to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck combines disruption and aggression to keep the opponent on the back foot and secure a fast victory.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using Cloudpost and Tron lands, while controlling the game with spells like Force of Will and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's options with cards like Stock Up and Lórien Revealed, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. The win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and artifacts, backed up by additional threats such as The One Ring and Thundertrap Trainer.

The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures and spells to control the opponent's resources while maintaining a steady aggro pressure. It looks to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, while using Aether Vial to cheat in creatures like Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition for additional disruption. The deck also utilizes powerful equipment like Swords to Plowshares and Stoneforge Mystic to efficiently deal with threats. With a mix of control and aggression, the deck aims to outvalue and overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently assemble and cast the Doomsday combo to win the game. By utilizing cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly, along with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand, the deck aims to set up a winning combination of cards such as Thassa's Oracle and Doomsday. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize helps protect the combo while interacting with the opponent's game plan. The deck seeks to win through a powerful and carefully planned sequence of plays.

The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and powerful removal spells. It relies on cards like Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan while using cards such as Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to accelerate its own mana production. The deck also has a strong late-game plan with cards like The One Ring and Sundering Eruption to finish off the opponent. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and aggression to secure victory.

This deck focuses on establishing a strong board presence with aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Thoughtseize. The deck aims to outpace the opponent by utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells, such as Solitude and Skyclave Apparition, to control the board and apply pressure. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional card advantage and versatility to outmaneuver opponents in longer games. Overall, the deck seeks to utilize the Death & Taxes strategy to disrupt and overwhelm opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, and then bring them back into play for a devastating attack using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes a mix of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to control the opponent's hand and graveyard. The fast mana acceleration provided by cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal allows for explosive plays, making this combo-reanimator deck a formidable force in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

Utilizing a combination of discard spells, fast mana, and powerful reanimation spells, this deck aims to quickly put a large threat into play from the graveyard, bypassing traditional mana costs and accelerating its game plan. By exploiting the graveyard as a resource, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, gaining a significant advantage in the early game. By disrupting opponents' hands with cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the game and set up its combo pieces for a decisive victory.

Utilizing fast mana and discard spells to quickly dump high-value creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield for massive advantage and to overpower the opponent's defenses, creating a powerful reanimator combo engine that overwhelms the opponent with strong threats, disruption, and card advantage.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It aims to control the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck also utilizes card filtering and card advantage to maintain tempo and consistency. By efficiently managing resources and making timely plays, this deck aims to outmaneuver and outpace the opponent, winning the game through a combination of early aggression and disruption. With a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and secure victory through tempo advantage.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. The deck includes powerful creatures like Voice of Victory and Amped Raptor, along with support cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Goblin Bombardment. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides a consistent source of mana acceleration. The deck aims to maintain board control and apply pressure early in the game to force the opponent to react defensively, ultimately leading to victory through aggressive tactics and efficient card plays.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo between Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. The deck also includes cards like Cunning Wish and Veil of Summer to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. With a mix of counter spells, card draw, and protection cards, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with massive threats that are difficult to deal with.

The main theme of this deck is to lock down the opponent's resources and prevent them from playing their cards effectively through the use of artifacts that disrupt their game plan. Cards such as Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, and Karn, the Great Creator are used to control the board and limit the opponent's options. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful artifacts like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and The One Ring to generate additional value and close out the game. Overall, this deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and control the game until victory is achieved.
